lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Highly organized horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters. The cluster size increases and spatial frequency decreases along the anterior-posterior axis, with the most prominent centroids localized along the mid-lateral line posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal blob rows at near-perpendicular angles, creating a rectilinear grid where high-luminance blobs serve as anchor nodes at each intersection.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a high-contrast luminance gradient with highlights on the superior edge and deep shadows on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs contained within the dorsal fin silhouette, with clusters primarily located in the basal and medial regions of the fin.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the pectoral fin displays a high-density 'stardust' pattern of micro-blobs, which are significantly smaller and more tightly packed than the primary lateral flank constellation.
